title: Unify the raw LLM provider interface across request versions
objective: Replace the split LlmProvider/LlmProviderV2 raw adapter seam with one overloaded LlmProvider.complete interface that accepts version-discriminated provider requests and returns the correlated provider response while preserving the versioned public completion contracts.

branch.name: wi-0004-unified-llm-provider
branch.rationale: The work item is processed as a serial set of scoped commits on the current repository branch; the branch name records the intended refactor boundary without requiring a topic branch.

request.text: Prepare a new .docs/work-items to refactor to a unified interface, removing the v2 specific variants. Commit the new work item. Process the new work item, committing after each task.

scope.name: unified-raw-provider
scope.description: Unify raw provider transport behind one LlmProvider.complete overload set using version-discriminated provider request and response unions.
scope.reason: The current LlmProvider/LlmProviderV2 split forces callers and orchestration code to select a version-specific method and does not scale cleanly to future request/response versions.

scope.name: provider-api-migration
scope.description: Update OpenRouterProvider, completeV2 orchestration, exports, deterministic fixtures, and generated declarations to consume the unified complete method.
scope.reason: All implementations and tests must use one provider method while preserving v1 raw text and v2 normalized tool responses.

nonGoals.name: public-contract-version-removal
nonGoals.description: Do not remove or merge llm/request/v1, llm/request/v2, llm/response/v1, or llm/response/v2 contracts.
nonGoals.reason: Versioned public request and response envelopes remain compatibility boundaries.

nonGoals.name: behavioral-expansion
nonGoals.description: Do not change tool orchestration policy, finish_reason semantics, retry bounds, provider wire formats, or tool-result behavior.
nonGoals.reason: WI-0004 is an interface refactor over the behavior delivered by WI-0003.

nonGoals.name: unrelated-worktree-changes
nonGoals.description: Do not stage or modify the pre-existing request-schema edits outside this work item.
nonGoals.reason: Those changes predate WI-0004 and are unrelated to provider interface unification.

items.name: single-provider-method
items.description: The exported raw provider contract exposes one complete method that accepts v1 and v2 provider requests and returns the correlated provider result.
items.reason: Consumers should not select between complete and completeV2 methods for provider transport.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The generated public declarations contain one LlmProvider.complete overload set for v1/v2 requests and no LlmProviderV2 interface or completeV2 provider method.

items.name: version-correlated-types
items.description: Provider request and response unions preserve version correlation and remain extensible for future provider protocol versions.
items.reason: A single union method must not collapse all callers to an uncorrelated string-or-object response.

acceptanceCriteria.description: TypeScript overloads infer string for v1 provider requests and ProviderCompletionResponse for v2 provider requests, with an explicit discriminator available for future versions.

items.name: implementation-migration
items.description: OpenRouterProvider and v2 orchestration use the unified complete method without changing v1 output, v2 tool behavior, finish_reason decisions, or response envelopes.
items.reason: The refactor must be behavior-preserving while removing the v2-specific raw provider method.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Deterministic v1/v2 provider tests, tool-loop tests, finish_reason tests, response-schema tests, and existing service-dispatch tests remain passing after the migration.

items.name: variant-removal-documentation
items.description: The public exports and documentation describe the unified provider interface and do not advertise the removed v2-specific raw provider variants.
items.reason: A successful refactor must be discoverable and must not leave callers on the obsolete split interface.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Generated declarations, index exports, tests, and SKILL.md consistently reference the unified LlmProvider.complete boundary; completeV2 remains absent as a provider method.
